items.title: Nvidia's black eye: One company isn't run by one person
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi argues that investors shouldn’t lean too heavily on a CEO’s personal life amid the crisis surrounding Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Why Nvidia's board really needs to lay out Jensen Huang's succession plan
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) stock is under fire over CEO Jensen Huang's acknowledged affair with Alice Huang, who is suspected of being a spy for Chinese intelligence. The company's board is launching a probe into the affair.Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares some of his thoughts and outlines the importance of a succession plan.
